# UnitSwift

> UnitSwift is a free, fast, client-side online unit converter offering 70 dedicated calculators across weight, length, temperature, volume, speed, area, local units, and data with no sign-up and no tracking.

## Weight Converters

- [Kilograms to Pounds Converter (kg to lb)](https://unitswift.org/kg-to-pounds): Convert kilograms to pounds using pounds = kilograms × 2.20462262.
- [Pounds to Kilograms Converter (lb to kg)](https://unitswift.org/pounds-to-kg): Convert pounds to kilograms using kilograms = pounds × 0.45359237.
- [Grams to Ounces Converter (g to oz)](https://unitswift.org/gram-to-ounce): Convert grams to ounces using ounces = grams ÷ 28.3495231.
- [Ounces to Grams Converter (oz to g)](https://unitswift.org/ounce-to-gram): Convert ounces to grams using grams = ounces × 28.3495231.
- [Kilograms to Grams Converter (kg to g)](https://unitswift.org/kg-to-gram): Convert kilograms to grams using grams = kilograms × 1,000.
- [Grams to Kilograms Converter (g to kg)](https://unitswift.org/gram-to-kg): Convert grams to kilograms using kilograms = grams ÷ 1,000.
- [Pounds to Ounces Converter (lb to oz)](https://unitswift.org/pounds-to-ounce): Convert pounds to ounces using ounces = pounds × 16.
- [Ounces to Pounds Converter (oz to lb)](https://unitswift.org/ounce-to-pounds): Convert ounces to pounds using pounds = ounces ÷ 16.
- [Kilograms to Ounces Converter (kg to oz)](https://unitswift.org/kg-to-ounce): Convert kilograms to ounces using ounces = kilograms × 35.2739619.
- [Pounds to Grams Converter (lb to g)](https://unitswift.org/pounds-to-grams): Convert pounds to grams using grams = pounds × 453.59237.

## Temperature Converters

- [Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter (°C to °F)](https://unitswift.org/celsius-to-fahrenheit): Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32.
- [Fahrenheit to Celsius Converter (°F to °C)](https://unitswift.org/fahrenheit-to-celsius): Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius using °C = (°F − 32) ÷ 1.8.
- [Celsius to Kelvin Converter (°C to K)](https://unitswift.org/celsius-to-kelvin): Convert Celsius to Kelvin using K = °C + 273.15.
- [Kelvin to Celsius Converter (K to °C)](https://unitswift.org/kelvin-to-celsius): Convert Kelvin to Celsius using °C = K − 273.15.
- [Fahrenheit to Kelvin Converter (°F to K)](https://unitswift.org/fahrenheit-to-kelvin): Convert Fahrenheit to Kelvin using K = (°F − 32) × 5/9 + 273.15.

## Volume Converters

- [Liters to Gallons Converter (L to US gal)](https://unitswift.org/liter-to-gallon): Convert liters to US liquid gallons using gallons = liters ÷ 3.785411784.
- [Gallons to Liters Converter (US gal to L)](https://unitswift.org/gallon-to-liter): Convert US liquid gallons to liters using liters = gallons × 3.785411784.
- [Milliliters to Liters Converter (mL to L)](https://unitswift.org/ml-to-liter): Convert milliliters to liters using liters = milliliters ÷ 1,000.
- [Liters to Milliliters Converter (L to mL)](https://unitswift.org/liter-to-ml): Convert liters to milliliters using milliliters = liters × 1,000.
- [Gallons to Milliliters Converter (US gal to mL)](https://unitswift.org/gallon-to-ml): Convert US liquid gallons to milliliters using milliliters = gallons × 3,785.4118.

## Speed Converters

- [MPH to KM/H Speed Converter (mph to km/h)](https://unitswift.org/mph-to-kmh): Convert miles per hour to kilometers per hour using km/h = mph × 1.609344.
- [KM/H to MPH Speed Converter (km/h to mph)](https://unitswift.org/kmh-to-mph): Convert kilometers per hour to miles per hour using mph = km/h ÷ 1.609344.

- [Acres to Kanal Converter (ac to kanal)](https://unitswift.org/acre-to-kanal): Convert acres to kanal using kanal = acres × 8.
- [Kanal to Acres Converter (kanal to ac)](https://unitswift.org/kanal-to-acre): Convert kanal to acres using acres = kanal × 0.125.
- [Square Yards to Marla Converter (sq yd to marla)](https://unitswift.org/square-yards-to-marla): Convert square yards to marla using marla = square yards ÷ 30.25.
- [Marla to Square Yards Converter (marla to sq yd)](https://unitswift.org/marla-to-square-yards): Convert marla to square yards using square yards = marla × 30.25.
- [Marla to Square Meters Converter (marla to sq m)](https://unitswift.org/marla-to-square-meter): Convert marla to square meters using sq m = marla × 25.2929.

## Data Storage Converters

- [MB to GB Converter (Megabytes to Gigabytes)](https://unitswift.org/mb-to-gb): Convert megabytes to gigabytes using GB = MB ÷ 1,024.
- [GB to MB Converter (Gigabytes to Megabytes)](https://unitswift.org/gb-to-mb): Convert gigabytes to megabytes using MB = GB × 1,024.
- [KB to MB Converter (Kilobytes to Megabytes)](https://unitswift.org/kb-to-mb): Convert kilobytes to megabytes using MB = KB ÷ 1,024.
- [MB to KB Converter (Megabytes to Kilobytes)](https://unitswift.org/mb-to-kb): Convert megabytes to kilobytes using KB = MB × 1,024.
- [GB to TB Converter (Gigabytes to Terabytes)](https://unitswift.org/gb-to-tb): Convert gigabytes to terabytes using TB = GB ÷ 1,024.
- [TB to GB Converter (Terabytes to Gigabytes)](https://unitswift.org/tb-to-gb): Convert terabytes to gigabytes using GB = TB × 1,024.
